author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Today Bob and I dive into CITY CRUSHERS; a 6mm 90's-Style mass-combat game. Quick alternating activations and simple army construction let's you put a ton of models on the table and get through a game in about 90 minutes. Love Epic scale games? Check it out!

Check out CITY CRUSHERS HERE - https://vanguardminiatures.co.uk/product/city-crushers-epic-battles-boxed-game/

Check out their new game COSMO CRUSHERS HERE - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/troublemakergames/cosmoscrushers-a-tabletop-wargame
